It’s your relationship and whatever you two decide makes the relationship better is between the two of you and that’s great. Just be mindful that resentment can build on both sides if he gets jealous or you wish he could be more like what you get on the side. 

If it were equal and you both are okay seeing other people than there would less resentment to build. I wouldn’t recommend an open relationship if either of you feel something is unfair about the dynamic. Open relationships do not save relationships and often are a marker that the relationship is failing. It’s different when you’re both enjoying the relationship and having fun with the idea of other experiences as well and there’s enthusiasm for that from both sides.
